name: dashboard
description: Protected dashboard (client-side) with sidebar navigation, proxy-based route protection, user settings, and a typed RPC data-fetching example
notes: Pure frontend feature. Reads the session with useSession() and fetches data through the typed Hono RPC client (@/lib/api-client). Assumes the separated backend (apps/api) and @workspace/db already exist, and that apps/web/lib/api-client.ts and the /api proxy in next.config.ts are in place.
